title: 第五章 周青梅第六章 悉听尊便
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
看着眼前浮现出来的系统提示，方书文恍然，这算是将主动权交到了自己的手里。
第一次的护卫任务，是因为当时自己已经成为了周家护院，所以默认领取。
那这么说来，以后自己的任务，还得自己去寻找了？
想到这里，他看向了周飞雄
“周老爷，敢问一句，你可知道今夜这些对头的来历？”
周飞雄闻言苦笑一声
“实不相瞒，老夫所知和少侠一般无二。
“不过少侠放心，小女毕竟出身珠玑阁，只要今夜平安度过，将此事禀报师门，无论对方是谁，料想都可解决。”
方书文心中略微犹豫。
这帮人武功不弱，也不知道是否还有其他强手。
他有些不愿意卷入这是非之中。
但眼看着出现在眼前的任务，以及方才入手的【易筋经】奖励，也不愿意轻易放弃。
周飞雄说的没错，珠玑阁到底不比别处。
权势，高手，财富应有尽有。
周青梅身为珠玑阁的真传弟子，若是有他们出面斡旋的话，想来这场风波很快就会消弭于无形之中。
再怎么，也不会超过三个月。
看了看手中的银票，又琢磨了一下当中的可行性。
方书文终究点了点头，将这件事情答应下来。
反正真到了事不可为的情况，自己抽身而退就是。
多重考虑之后，他选择了【领取任务】。

【领取成功！】
【当前护卫任务保护周青梅，直到危机解除。】
【叮！恭喜宿主，任务存续期间，获得两倍资质悟性加持，放弃任务或任务结束自动取消。】
“哦？”
方书文微微一愣，倒是没想到，新手奖励之后，接取任务还有资质悟性增幅的福利。
虽然两倍不能跟新手奖励的五倍相比，但有总好过没有。
他看了周飞雄一眼
“好，这一单买卖在下接了。”
“好，好好！！”
周飞雄赶紧自腰间拽下来了一块牌子交给了方书文
“这是老夫的腰牌，少侠自这暗道一路往前，可以离开周家范围。
content_en:
Looking at the system prompts that appeared in front of him, Fang Shuwen suddenly realized that this was putting the initiative in his own hands.
The first escort mission was because I had already become the Zhou Family Nursing Home at that time, so I accepted it by default.
So, in the future, you will have to find your own missions by yourself?
Thinking of this, he looked at Zhou Feixiong
"Mr. Zhou, I dare to ask, do you know the origins of these enemies tonight?"
Zhou Feixiong smiled bitterly when he heard this
"To be honest, what I know is the same as what I know about young heroes.
"But don't worry, young hero, my daughter is from Zhuji Pavilion after all. As long as she spends the night safely and reports the matter to the master, no matter who the other party is, it can be solved. "
Fang Shuwen hesitated slightly.
This group of people is not weak in martial arts, and I don’t know if there are other strong opponents.
He was somewhat unwilling to get involved in right and wrong.
But seeing the task in front of me and the reward of [Yi Jin Jing] that I had just obtained, I was not willing to give up easily.
Zhou Feixiong was right, Zhuji Pavilion was no better than anywhere else.
Power, masters, and wealth are all there.
As Zhou Qingmei's true disciple of Zhuji Pavilion, if they had come forward to mediate, I think this turmoil would have been eliminated quickly.
No matter what, it will not exceed three months.
I looked at the banknote in my hand and thought about the feasibility of it.
Fang Shuwen finally nodded and agreed to the matter.
Anyway, when it comes to a situation where nothing can be done, just retreat on your own.
After much consideration, he chose [Accept Mission].
[Received successfully! 】
[The current escort mission is to protect Zhou Qingmei until the crisis is resolved. 】
[Ding! Congratulations to the host. During the duration of the mission, you will receive twice the qualification and understanding blessings. If you give up the mission or the mission ends, it will be automatically canceled. 】
"Oh? "
Fang Shuwen was slightly startled, but he didn't expect that after the novice reward, accepting tasks would also provide the benefit of increasing his qualifications and understanding.
Although twice is not comparable to five times the novice reward, it is better than nothing.
He glanced at Zhou Feixiong
"Okay, I'll take this transaction next time. "
"Okay, okay! ! "
Zhou Feixiong quickly pulled a sign from his waist and handed it to Fang Shuwen
"This is my waist card. The young hero can go all the way from this secret passage and leave the confines of the Zhou family.
